release_notes:
ReadySetPDF 4.0.13

The asset tree can select pages across files, drag those pages into another PDF, and undo the move. Arrange uses the same list. Join and split can run on the selection. Each page shows its size. Color pages are labeled Color, Pagemix, or Colormix. The size menu can select every page of one size. Clear in the asset manager leaves the recipe in place.

Margin and gutter fields stay inside the Tools pane, and the explanation wraps under them.

Resize places the page from a 3 by 3 anchor with horizontal and vertical offsets, and the content keeps its size. Crop has a step size and up and down arrows on each edge, and the monitor follows those changes.

The bleed preview shows white space around the page and a Cut square for the trim. Grid auto max-fit counts the same rows and columns a manual layout can place. Loading a millimetre grid while the app unit is inches no longer builds a page that is too large.

Mail merge shrinks a line that is wider than its box, and stamps UTF-8 text, including an apostrophe, with a font that can draw the character. The Real Time Monitor shows that variable text. Bleed, Crop, Resize, Grid, and mail merge update the monitor as soon as you change them, before a step is saved.

After this hot-fix installs, the new window starts with Explorer's token. You can drop files onto the asset manager and the recipe manager on that first launch, without starting the app a second time.
